Optional Computation of Net Earnings from Self-Employment
(See “Who Can Use Schedule SE”)

Generally, this part may be used only if you meet any of the following tests:

A Your gross farm profits (Schedule F (Form 1040), line 31 or line 87) were not more than $2,400, or
B_ Your gross farm profits (Schedule F (Form 1040), line 31 or line 87) were more than $2,400 and your net farm profits,

(Schedule F (Form 1040), line 56 or line 89) were less than $1,600, or

Your net nonfarm profits (Schedule C (Form 1040), line 32) were less than $1,600 and also less than two-thirds (24)

of your gross nonfarm income (Schedule C (Form 1040), line 5).
See instructions for other limitations.
